hyperedges.description: Complete pre-enlistment journey for NS-liable males
hyperedges.sequence: Exit Permit notice (age 13) -> NS Registration (age 16.5) -> Medical Screening -> Optional Medical Review -> Optional Deferment -> Optional Pre-enlistee IPPT -> Enlistment Day -> Basic Training

hyperedges.composition: NS consists of 2 years full-time + 10 years operationally ready, served in SAF/SCDF/SPF

hyperedges.flow: Medical screening -> PES/MCS grade or Pending Medical Review -> Further Reporting Order -> Medical appointments -> Medical Classification Centre -> Final grade determines basic training duration

hyperedges.description: Path to reduce full-time NS duration through fitness
hyperedges.condition: Achieve 61+ IPPT score AND PES A/B1 (before Oct 2027) or eligible under MCS (from Oct 2027)
hyperedges.benefit: 8-week reduction in full-time NS and exemption from Physical Training Phase

hyperedges.description: How to manage education during NS
Career and education opportunities during NS
phases: Towards end: Career fairs and workshops

hyperedges.description: Safety standards and culture in NS training
Legal obligations and enforcement for NS
hyperedges.penalties: Up to $10,000 fine and/or up to 3 years imprisonment for non-compliance

key_themes: National Service (NS) is compulsory for male Singapore Citizens and PRs
NS consists of 2 years full-time service + 10 years operationally ready reserve
Pre-enlistment process begins at age 13 with Exit Permit notice and culminates at age 18+ with enlistment
Medical fitness (PES or MCS) determines basic training duration and suitability
Pre-enlistee IPPT performance (61+ points) can reduce full-time NS by 8 weeks
Deferment for pre-university studies is available; disruption for university is available during service
Work-Learn Schemes and SPS-IC offer sponsored qualifications during NS
Comprehensive wellbeing support includes buddy system, Care Hub, counselling, and financial assistance
Safety is prioritized through ISO 45001 standards, leadership emphasis, and safety pause right
Multiple recruitment and application pathways (ARC, NRC, AFRC, DIRC) for different vocations
OneNS portal is central platform for all NS applications and tracking
CPF-based financial schemes provide family protection and retirement planning
Employment laws protect workers' rights, with dispute resolution through MOM agencies
Retrenchment alternatives (redeployment, temporary layoff, shorter work) are encouraged

data_quality_notes.coverage: Comprehensive coverage of NS pre-enlistment, service structure, medical assessment, education management, career development, and wellbeing
data_quality_notes.extracted_vs_inferred: Majority of nodes and edges directly extracted from documents; some inferred relationships to organizational hierarchies (e.g., ICA role, MOM subagencies)
data_quality_notes.ambiguities: Some roles not explicitly stated (e.g., LifeSG vs OneNS platform distinction, exact medical appointment locations)
data_quality_notes.completeness: Document set covers parent and pre-enlistee perspectives, employment law, and CPF schemes; limited coverage of operational NS details
